413-1420-2178.easyPrerequisites:
Godsire doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Godsire.
413-1420-2178.description:
Activate Godsire by tapping it, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Godsire triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Godsire.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.

1981-2415-2842-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Blood Artist and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1981-2415-2842-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4890-7936.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4890-7936.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Dominion Saboteur and Dack's Duplicate each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dominion Saboteur trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Dack's Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4890-7936.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2021-2060-6774-7267.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

6723-7297-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
6723-7297-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
6723-7297-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1292-3117-5078-7356.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and putting Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Jace's Erasure triggers, causing you to mill Sensei's Divining Top.
When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

703-5465-7012.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {4}{U}{U} due to Doc Aurlock.
When Astral Dragon enters, it triggers, creating two copies of Airbender Ascension that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
When the Airbender Ascension tokens enter, they trigger, airbending Astral Dragon and up to one other creature.
Cast Astral Dragon from exile by paying {0} due to Doc Aurlock.
Repeat from step 2.
703-5465-7012.notes: The other Airbender Ascension trigger can be used to blink creatures you control. You would cast that creature in between step 3 and step 4, blinking it each iteration.

942-2523-4549.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Samwise.
942-2523-4549.description:
Kill Samwise. When it dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Samwise that is a 2/2 Zombie that isn't legendary.
When the Samwise token enters, it triggers, returning Samwise from your graveyard to your hand. and causing the token Samwise to become your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping the token Samwise, adding {W}.
Cast Samwise by paying {1}{W}.
Put the token Samwise into your graveyard due to the legend rule. When it dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of it that is a 2/2 Zombie that isn't legendary.
When the Samwise token enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping the nontoken Samwise, adding {W}.
Resolve the Samwise trigger, causing the token Samwise to become your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Put the nontoken Samwise into your graveyard due to the legend rule. When it dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Samwise that is a 2/2 Zombie that isn't legendary.
Repeat from step 2.

3621-5231-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard with haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.
3621-5231-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can just do step 1 repeatedly.

3129-4017-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
3129-4017-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}
Repeat from step 1.

1069-3552-5499-7060.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-3552-5499-7060.description:
Activate Blaring Recruiter by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Warrior.
Activate the Warrior by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1939-3490-4017-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1939-3490-4017-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
When the Servo dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Lunarch Veteran or Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain life
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

454-1597-1978.description:
Cause Gyre Sage to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Gyre Sage by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Gyre Sage.
Repeat from step 2.

2178-5173-6095-6798.easyPrerequisites:
Zul Ashur, Lich Lord does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Zul Ashur.
2178-5173-6095-6798.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting Shambling Ghast.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambing Ghast dies, it and Zul Ashur trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zul Ashur trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1912-2043-4365-4715.description:
Activate Urza by paying {4}, creating two token copies of Prized Statue that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
When the Prized Statue tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

1308-1563-2457-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1308-1563-2457-4068.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

386-790-2152.notablePrerequisites: A player has a number of cards in hand that is greater than or equal to 10 minus the lowest amount of poison counters an opponent has.
386-790-2152.description:
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and then draw a number of cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.
Fate Unraveler triggers for each card drawn this way, giving each opponent a poison counter for each card they drew.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters

851-2457-3480-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

222-527-1251-2438.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1251-2438.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

628-5231-5263.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero, adding {R}.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader, adding {R}.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

112-698-5195.notablePrerequisites:
You have gained at least 3 life this turn.
Will does not have summoning sickness.
112-698-5195.description:
Activate Will by tapping it, reducing the cost of all white and/or blue spells you cast this turn by at least {3}.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {U} due to Will's ability, targeting any permanent.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

302-1636-2467-4587-5072.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
At most {1} plus two mana of any two different colors available, plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
302-1636-2467-4587-5072.description:
Activate all Slivers you control by tapping them, adding one mana of any color for each Sliver tapped this way.
Cast Sliver Grandmother from the command zone by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Sliver Grandmother enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers.
Holding priortiy, activate Sliver Gravemother by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate all Slivers you control by tapping them, adding one mana of any color for each Sliver tapped this way.
Activate Sliver Gravemother by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
Choose not to return Sliver Gravemother to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Sliver Gravemother ability, causing each player to discard a card.
Activate Sliver Gravemother's encore ability by paying {5} and exiling it.
Choose to return Sliver Gravemother to the command zone from exile.
Resolve the Sliver Gravemother ability, creating a token copy of it for each opponent you have.
When the Sliver Gravemother tokens enter the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate the Sliver Gravemother tokens by tapping them, adding at least three mana of any color(s).
Resolve the first Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate all Slivers you control by tapping them, adding one mana of any color for each Sliver tapped this way.
Repeat from step 15 for each remaining trigger.
Repeat from step 1.
